<thought>To locate the appropriate retrosynthetic template, I will query the template catalog without any functional‑group filters, requesting a modest number of entries. This will return a list of template IDs that are applicable to the target molecule. I can then examine those IDs to find one that matches a Friedel‑Crafts acylation (breaks a halide and forms a ketone).</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CCl)cc3)c2N)c1",
    "limit": 20
}
</action_input>
